column1: # Slot lists of the Linux-Hardware.org DMI collection (github.com/linuxhw/DMI, commit 57b21bc, CC BY 4.0), server dumps.
# A list is a dump as the ledger of MemorY keeps it: system maker and product, board, processor records, and every memory
# device once. It holds slot names, product and processor names, and no serial number, part number or module maker.
# list, dumps: the number of the list and how many dumps have it (dumps.tsv names them); sockets: processor records;
# vendor, product, board; processor, signature (family/model/stepping), present (one character per processor record).
# Per slot: populated, type, locator, bank_locator; socket and channel as the first implementation reads the slot list;
# then the place the board gives the slot: state, reason, socket (hub for memory on the chipset), channel, channel name,
# position, the DIMM index of the bank locator, and how the place was found. Written once from the sketch of phase C100;
# a value changed later is changed by hand, with its reason in the notes of the phase.
